terra.problem: The joke attributes texting everybody he knows to Adoni-zedek rather than making it a modern comparison. The text says he sent word to four kings.
The passage does not say whether the king packs a box.
The explanation says Gibeon sent to Israel because they had made peace. The passage does not give that reason.
The snack joke mentions food other than cookies.
The passage does not say that nobody was sent home.
The passage does not establish that nobody gets tied up. It simply does not mention chains.
The reference to an angel going before the camp is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
